identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Tislelizumab in Combination With Disitamab-vedotin as Neoadjuvant Therapy for HER2-positive High-risk Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma (UTUC)
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Open Clinical Trial of Efficacy and Safety of Tislelizumab in Combination With Disitamab-vedotin as Neoadjuvant Therapy for HER2-positive High-risk Upper Tract Urothelial Carcinoma (UTUC)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy treatment can be used for specific UTUC patients, especially for highly staged and/or grade tumors, such as kidneys with potentially decreased renal function after RNU. Neoadjuvant therapy is a series of treatments administered preoperatively for UTUC, mainly chemotherapy, and in recent years, novel therapies of immunotherapy have emerged. Since conventional cisplatin neoadjuvant regimens also require high preoperative renal function, neoadjuvant therapy regimens such as immunotherapy provide more effective and feasible treatments for patients who are intolerant to current cisplatin chemotherapy regimens. The aim of this study was to explore the efficacy and safety of the combination of disitamab vedotin, a human epidermal growth factor receptor-2 (HER-2) targeted ADC, and tislelizumab, a humanised PD-1 ICIs, as neoadjuvant treatment for non-metastatic, high-risk, HER-2 expressing UTUC. In our study, patients enrolled will receive neoadjuvant tislelizumab plus disitamab-vedotin therapy followed by radical nephroureterectomy (RNU), distal ureterectomy (DU) or ureteroscopic ablation (UA) .

interventions.name: tislelizumab+disitamab-vedotin
interventions.description: Patients enrolled will receive 3 cycles of tislelizumab 200 mg in combination with disitamab-vedotin (RC48) 2.0mg/kg intravenously.

primaryOutcomes.description: no residual tumor was detected in the specimen from RNU/DU by pathological examination

secondaryOutcomes.description: Classified in accordance with CTCAE version 5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From treatment initiation to the end of treatment at 90 days.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from treatment initiated to death from any cause
defined as the time from treatment initiated to the first occurrence of tumor recurrence (including in the upper urinary tract, bladder or metastasis).
no target lesions found in imaging examination
More than 30% decrease in sum of diameters of target lesion in imaging examination
More than 20% increase in sum of diameters or appearance of new lesions in imaging examination

otherOutcomes.description: Defined as the time from treatment initiation to the first occurrence of tumor recurrence that met the indications for RNU, metastatic disease or death from any cause
